text.p: A senior British Conservative member of parliament, Michael Jopling, is seriously ill in hospital after an accident in a charity race, a source in his office said.
"His condition is serious but stable," the source said. Prime Minister John Major's ruling Conservative Party has 322 seats in parliament, exactly the same as all the opposition parties combined.
A by-election next week in the Wirrall South constituency in north-west England following the death of Conservative MP Barry Porter is already expected to push the government into a minority of one.
Major must call an election by May at the latest, but if he dips into a minority, he will be forced to depend on minority parties for his survival.
The Conservatives survived a censure motion against Agriculture MInister Douglas Hogg on Monday by 13 votes, largely thanks to the help of Ulster Unionist MPs from Northern Ireland.
